entities.name: Training-Free
entities.description: A category of GraphRAG approaches that do not require explicit training, often used with closed-source LLMs like GPT-4, relying on prompt engineering.

entities.name: Training-Based
entities.description: A category of GraphRAG approaches that involve training or fine-tuning models using supervised signals to adapt to specific task objectives.

entities.name: GPT-4
entities.description: A closed-source LLM mentioned as a component used in Training-Free methods for retrieval or generation.

entities.name: Joint training
entities.description: A procedural strategy involving the simultaneous training of retrievers and generators to enhance their synergy and performance on downstream tasks.

entities.name: Information retrieval
entities.description: A downstream application area where GraphRAG methods are applied to find relevant information.

entities.name: Content generation
entities.description: A downstream application area where GraphRAG methods are applied to generate text or other content.

relationships.description: The text states Training-Free methods are commonly employed when using closed-source LLMs such as GPT-4. Note: 'USES_KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH' is the closest allowed relationship for utilizing a model component, though semantically it is 'USES_MODEL'.
Training-Free methods are used to control retrieval capabilities.
Training-Free methods are used to control generation capabilities.
Training-Based methods enhance the quality of retrieved content.
Training-Based methods enhance the quality of generated content.
Joint training is a specific collaborative approach within the broader context of training methods to enhance synergy.
